name: Slopper Studio 1.0 Beta
notes:
First public beta.
- Video: Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0, MiniMax H3 (kie.ai or fal)
- Image: GPT Image 2.6 / 2.5, Nano Banana, FLUX 3
- Workflows with right-click steps, character packs, master backgrounds, storyboard tools (alpha)
- Free local upscaling, pro video player, Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini docks
- Only you can start generations
- Updates from Settings -> Updates

mac.name: Slopper Studio 1.0 Beta · Mac Alpha Preview
mac.notes: Mac Alpha Preview: first Mac version (Apple Silicon). Chat buttons open Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini in their own windows; local upscaling is Windows-only.
